description: This file implements the EntityCondition class, which is a part of the OFBiz mini-language framework. It defines behavior for handling the <entity-condition> element within a small embedded language for entity operations, including validation, execution, and artifact info gathering.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: Represents the <entity-condition> element within the mini-language, responsible for executing entity find operations based on conditions, validating attributes, and providing artifact info.

methods.name: EntityCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes EntityCondition instance, performing validation and setting up the finder based on provided XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the entity condition logic, performing the entity find using the specified criteria.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information such as the entity name involved for documentation or analysis.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the entity condition, mainly for debugging.
